notes.title: Unleash Your Inner Badass - Psycho Bathroom BIG Update!
notes.content:
Hey Psycho Bathroom players, it has come to our attention that only 13.2% of you have beaten the game! That means a whopping 86.8% haven't unlocked their true badass potential.  We can't let that stand! So, we're rolling out the BIG Sword Mode (a.k.a. Easy Mode) to help you unleash your inner badass and make DDmeow's dream comes true!

Check out the trailer here!
[previewyoutube=6fRCcXAcX3I;full][/previewyoutube]

This update brings you:
[list]
[*] Long Sword Mode: Switch it on in the menu and marvel at your sword's newfound ridiculous length!
[*] 2 New Achievements: "I am a badass!" and "I feel like a Badass!"
[/list]

It's FREE! Yes, again, it's a free update!

Now go slice and dice your way through Psycho Bathroom with your absurdly huge sword, and show those pesky filths who's boss.

But wait, there's more! Interested in DDmeow's new life on Earth? Register now for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign for Cyber Paradise!

notes.title: Record with the new in-game timer and submit your speedrun now!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

With the new in-game timer, loading speed and cutscene no longer affect your speedrun time! 
Speedrunners, submit your best run to [url=https://www.speedrun.com/psycho_bathroom ]https://www.speedrun.com/psycho_bathroom[/url] now (or anytime you want)!

Just keep in mind the rules:
[list]
[*] Recording must start from the menu screen
[*] Game version number (At bottom right corner) must be visible (see pic 1)
[*] Must start a new game
[*] In-game timer must be visible  (see pic 2)
[*] Recording must include the time and day at the getting ticket scene  (see pic 3)
[*] You can use RT/ Q to speed up the cutscenes
[*] No video editing
[*] Real-time commentary with or without showing your face is allowed (Just make sure not to block the timer and version number)
[/list]

pic 1:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/bce7877c67ff1ddf552a328cf716bc9c5ef41362.png[/img]
pic 2:

notes.title: Psycho Bathroom: - 2 new bosses and a trap (Devlog 26 Jan 2022)
notes.content:
Hey there!

[h2]Another update as promised. This month we've made quite some progress.[/h2]

First, 2 new bosses!

Boss - Sausage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/73e606fa60ff3eeff19ca650b25db5e8430a2802.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/1e934d38218020408e061ff2e1a02f757bac02ea.gif[/img]

Boss - Boomerang
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/bbcf27eaa9b2b01399f1e04d636644ad752a0bb4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/677ad8f818a21e3e2a3bd97a8b72d2d3f2735f2a.gif[/img]

And then, a trap.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/c31941b93e22914a2543d4dc239ec6961857477e.gif[/img]
If the water trap in the drain is not filled with water, it will occasionally spray filth.

A dialogue system for cutscenes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/92f335752d4b4bf0fec2644e0ca0f0495f8780d6.png[/img]
Now there's story progression after each battle - no matter you win or lose! 

The story is a short one. Just to add some flavour to the game and a little of character development and world-building. It's about 70% written now. 

Controller vibration is added for PC version. Well, actually, the web version will not get any more new updates. As we add more content, the loading time would become unbearably long. The PC version on steam is free anyway. Anyone with a PC can play it on steam.

Expected launch - we are targeting April. The next update will probably be our launch date announcement with a new trailer and some gameplay videos.

notes.title: DevLog #5 and what we have been doing.
notes.content:
This devlog was written in June. Since then we have been working on a new framework. So far We have made a moving camera for a larger stage, parallax effect, a dynamic dialogue system, inventory system, audio system and some other invisible stuff.  When the framework is ready, we will apply it to Psycho Bathroom and expand the game. Thanks for staying with us!

BTW, we are testing this new WIP framework by making another mini-game. It will be announced when the first episode is ready. It is a funny visual novel with RPG mechanics. Well, actually I am not sure what genre it should be categorized as. Maybe it can also be called an interactive story? 

So here is the long overdue devlog:

[h1]DevLog #5[/h1]

[b]Secret Companions:[/b]
After beating the game, the player will acquire a random companion. At the moment there are only 2 companions available. Each has different abilities. More will be added later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/84cd89e59a84af02ecaa85c6fd20cde46620147f.jpg[/img]

[b]Special Move:[/b]
When the hit streak gets to 20, the player will get into a frantic state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/c0a877056b51a810eb151aff42cbbd4c36d1c04d.gif[/img]

[b]Point Multiplier for High Combo:[/b]
X2 for 8 hit streaks, X3 for 16 hit streaks, etc. More incentive for not getting hit now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739110/7ecdb9a7560f068d9f73145a76e3ea3d5a134884.gif[/img]
